correctness.rationale: Checked the source transition (a,b,d,e)->(s,t,d+e+b−ma+t−ms,d), the no-adjacent-one constraints, and the [-m,2m−1] window. Zeckendorf last-digit deletion g(z)=floor((z+2)/phi)−1 and irrational rotation delta={(X+2)/phi} produce an exact current difference/preceding-difference formula; density of irrational rotation and breakpoint coincidence counts give each r_m(d), with four endpoint adjustments counted even for m=1. Backward closure under deleting prefix last digits means no admissible pair is silently lost to window rejection, and out-of-window prefixes cannot reach an accepting difference c. Independently BFS-enumerated the entire exact integer state graph and per-d profile for m=1..25, all matched. Source verify_reachable.py independently counts m=1..60 plus numeral samples; its saved log is corroborative, not an infinite proof. Finite tests alone cannot establish the all-m formula.
